name: Example devcontainer for add-on repositories
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1 && docker ps | grep -q hassio_supervisor; then echo "Home Assistant supervisor is already running"; elif docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Docker is running but supervisor not found. Starting..."; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & sleep 5; else echo "Starting Home Assistant (Docker may take up to 30 seconds to start)..."; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & sleep 10; for i in {1..6}; do if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Docker started successfully"; break; else echo "Waiting for Docker to start... ($i/6)"; sleep 5; fi; done; if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Home Assistant supervisor starting..."; else echo "Warning: Docker may not have started yet. Check /tmp/supervisor.log"; fi; fi'
